correctness.rationale: For every positive linear-leakage directed rooted tree, solving the unique scalar storage balance gives the exact upward hinge recursion q_i=beta_i(w_i I+sum_child q_j-ell_i V_i)_+, beta_i=k_i/(ell_i+k_i). Positive w_i ensures a unique finite t_i crossing for each vertex. Strict positive derivative jumps propagate multiplicatively along already active ancestors, and are extinguished by any still-inactive ancestor; no cancellation is possible. Inductive capacity assignment V_i=F_i(t_i)/ell_i realizes arbitrary distinct t_i, so every visible-count 1..n occurs. Choosing root last at T yields an (n-1)-parameter open family with identical full outlet Q=L_root(I-T)_+, since post-T slopes depend only on known rates. Verified exact rational two-pool example and 1400 independent rational path/jump calculations from reconstructed package. Distinct t_i is needed only for the exact individual visibility formula, not continuity/convexity/n-kink bound.
residual_risks: Open interval of positive nonroot capacities yields an (n-1)-dimensional indistinguishable graph, not independent variation of all n capacities. The statement is steady-state and tree-only; no transient identification.
